linear_extrapolation.name: 线性外推法
linear_extrapolation.formula: 全年预测 = YTD实际 / 已过月份 × 12
linear_extrapolation.applicable: 费用趋势平稳、无明显季节性

seasonal_adjustment.name: 季节性调整法
seasonal_adjustment.formula: 全年预测 = YTD实际 / 去年同期占全年比

moving_average.name: 移动平均法
moving_average.formula: 预测月 = 最近N个月均值
moving_average.applicable: 短期预测，数据有随机波动

ytd_annualization.name: YTD年化法
ytd_annualization.formula: 全年预测 = YTD实际 × (12/已过月份) × 季节系数
ytd_annualization.applicable: 通用方法，需配合季节系数修正
